'''Mukand Limited''' (formerly Mukand Iron & Steel Works Limited) is an [[India]]-based manufacturer of [[stainless steel]], [[alloy steel]], and stainless steel billets, and is an exporter of hot rolled bars.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/2009/11/03/stories/2009110350390200.htm |title=Mukand to sell Kalwa unit land, use internal accruals to halve debt |newspaper=The Hindu Business Line |date=2009-11-03 |access-date=2011-01-07}}</ref>  Part of the [[Bajaj Group]], the company also produces steel castings, structurals, cranes, and other industrial machinery. Founded in 1937, Mukand is recognized for producing some of India's largest industrial cranes, including an 80-tonne, 60-metre-span gantry crane.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.mukand.com/associate_company.html |title=:: Welcome to Mukand Ltd :: India Based Manufacturer |access-date=2011-01-07 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110120235135/http://www.mukand.com/associate_company.html |archive-date=2011-01-20 }}</ref>

==History==
Mukand was established in 1929 in [[Lahore]] by Seth Mukand Lal. It was later acquired by [[Bajaj Group]] and moved to [[Mumbai]] in 1937. A steel plant at [[Kalwa, Thane]] commenced operations in 1965. It was renamed to Mukand Ltd from Mukand Iron & Steel Works Limited on 23 March 1989.<ref name="indiatimes1">{{cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/mukand-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-13382.cms |title=MUKANDLTD History | Mukand Ltd Company History & Profile |website=Economictimes.indiatimes.com |access-date=2011-01-07}}</ref>

It also operates a steel plant in Ginigera of Hospet district in collaboration with Kalyani Steel known as [[Kalyani Group#Hospet Steel Limited|Hospet Steel Ltd.]]<ref>{{Cite news |last=Mallinath |first=M |title=Mukand, Kalyani Steels In Strategic Link |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/specials/mukand-kalyani-steels-in-strategic-link-198082601010_1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220519203935/https://www.business-standard.com/article/specials/mukand-kalyani-steels-in-strategic-link-198082601010_1.html |archive-date=2022-05-19 |access-date=2025-08-05 |work=[[Business Standard]] |language=en}}</ref>
